summary.text: Thomas O'Dea represents Connecticut's 125th House District, which includes New Canaan, Darien and Stamford; the page says he was reelected to a sixth term in November 2022.

paragraphs.text: He was a member of the New Canaan Town Council from 2005 until January 2013, when he was elected to the state House, and was appointed Deputy House Republican Leader in December 2022.
He is a trial attorney who concentrates on civil litigation, with a JD from the Columbus School of Law at the Catholic University of America (1991).
